params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate- Final Service:}} Enemies that die near {{ci|Yorick}} will leave a ''grave'', as well as those he kills or damages with ''{{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}}''. '''Yorick''' can use ''{{ai|Awakening|Yorick}}'' and ''{{ai|Mourning Mist|Yorick}}'' to turn all ''graves'' into {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} that assist him in combat.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - The Cursed Horde:}} {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} will autonomously advance a lane upon entering combat within. '''Yorick''' can have up to 4 {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Final Service:}} Whenever '''Yorick''' uses ''{{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}}'' to score the killing blow on any enemy or damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, he raises a ''grave'' at {{tt|their location|Grave is spawned on top of the killed enemy and within close proximity of the damaged champion or monster}}. Additionally, a grave is passively raised for every {{pp|8th;7th;6th;5th;4th;3rd;2nd|1;3;5;7;9;11;13}} enemy that dies otherwise near him. Up to 4 ''graves'' can exist at once, lasting until '''Yorick''' exits the general area or {{tip|death|dies}}, with the furthest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit.
params.description2: '''Yorick''' can use ''{{ai|Awakening|Yorick}}'' and ''{{ais|Mourning Mist|Yorick}}'' mark to raise 1 {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} from each ''grave'' after a 1-second delay, consuming the ''graves'' in the process.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - The Cursed Horde:}} Up to 4 {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} can be active at once near '''Yorick''' or near '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|The Maiden|nolink=true}}''', with the nearest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|1000|Grave summon range}}|{{tt|2500|Grave despawn range, pending for test}}}}
params.notes: * Damaging a large monster or champion with {{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}} will only spawn 1 grave, even if it kills them.

blurb.plain: Innate- Final Service: Enemies that die near Yorick will leave a grave, as well as those he kills or damages with Last Rites. Yorick can use Awakening and Mourning Mist to turn all graves into Mist Walkers that assist him in combat.

blurb2.plain: Innate - The Cursed Horde: Mist Walkers will autonomously advance a lane upon entering combat within. Yorick can have up to 4 Mist Walkers.

description.plain: Innate - Final Service: Whenever Yorick uses Last Rites to score the killing blow on any enemy or damage an enemy champion or large monster, he raises a grave at their location. Additionally, a grave is passively raised for every ⟦pp⟧ enemy that dies otherwise near him. Up to 4 graves can exist at once, lasting until Yorick exits the general area or dies, with the furthest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit.

description2.plain: Yorick can use Awakening and Mourning Mist mark to raise 1 Mist Walker from each grave after a 1-second delay, consuming the graves in the process.

description3.plain: Innate - The Cursed Horde: Up to 4 Mist Walkers can be active at once near Yorick or near Maiden of the Mist, with the nearest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit.

description4.plain: See Pets for more details about Mist Walkers.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yorick}} summons {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} from the ''graves'' around him.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' exhumes a {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} under his command from each nearby ''grave''.
params.notes:
* ''Awakening'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Mist Walkers'' update their [[champion statistic|statistics]] correspondingly to '''Yorick's ''' during the periodic stat update, with the exception of their {{as|maximum health}}.
* ''Awakening'' cannot be cast without enough ''graves'' in '''range'''.

blurb.plain: Active: Yorick summons Mist Walkers from the graves around him.

description.plain: Active: Yorick exhumes a Mist Walker under his command from each nearby grave.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yorick}} summons a destructible ring of spirits at the target location that {{tip|airborne|knocks aside}} enemies hit. It remains as [[terrain]] against enemies for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' summons a ring of spirits around the target location that arises after a {{fd|0.75}}-second delay, {{tip|airborne|knocking aside}} enemies hit by the walls over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, though not through terrain. Within {{tt|210-units|Estimated}}, they are pulled inside; otherwise they are pushed away. The ring remains for 4 seconds as impassible [[terrain]] against enemies, granting {{tip|sight}} inside the ring.
params.description2: ''Dark Procession'' can only be targeted by enemy {{tip|champion}} basic attacks and {{tip|turrets}}. The wall takes 1 [[damage]] per attack from champions and is destroyed instantly from turret attacks.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|225|Spirits spawn radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|200|Sight radius from center of ring}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Dark Procession'' has a {{tip|turret}} prioritization value of 6, equal to that of {{ui|Blue Super Minion|link = super minion|super minions}}.
** '''Yorick's''' other {{tip|pet|pets}} each have a lower prioritization value, allowing him to delay the turret from targeting the {{ai|Eulogy of the Isles|Yorick|The Maiden}} or a {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} for one attack.
* ''Dark Procession'' deals 0 {{tip|proc damage|proc}} {{tip|true damage}} to enemies it knocks aside, which triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret and [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]], {{ri|Sudden Impact}} or applying {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}.
* The perimeter is made up of 18 units with 100 {{tip|pathing radius}} and 20 {{tip|gameplay radius}} each, which interact with effects like {{cai|I|Warwick}}. [https://youtu.be/OXjhRp1Rd5s?si=sHg_NfUBput9cC0F&t=42]
* '''Yorick''' marks any enemy champion within repeatedly while the cage persists in order to gain [[Assist#Indirect_triggers_of_assist_credit|assist credit]], lasting for the standard credit timer.

blurb.plain: Active: Yorick summons a destructible ring of spirits at the target location that knocks aside enemies hit. It remains as terrain against enemies for a few seconds.

description.plain: Active: Yorick summons a ring of spirits around the target location that arises after a 0.75-second delay, knocking aside enemies hit by the walls over 0.25 seconds, though not through terrain. Within 210-units, they are pulled inside; otherwise they are pushed away. The ring remains for 4 seconds as impassible terrain against enemies, granting sight inside the ring.

description2.plain: Dark Procession can only be targeted by enemy champion basic attacks and turrets. The wall takes 1 damage per attack from champions and is destroyed instantly from turret attacks.

variants.label: Sight radius from center of ring

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yorick}} hurls a globule of Black Mist that splashes at the target location dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies. Enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} hit are also shortly {{tip|slow|slowed}}, and marked ''Cursed'' for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: '''Yorick''' and his summons gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} toward a ''Cursed'' target. {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} will leap to a nearby ''Cursed'' target and focus them.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Cursed:}} The target has reduced {{as|armor}}. Nearby ''graves'' automatically raise a {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' hurls a globule of Black Mist that splashes across an area at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, down to a minimum threshold against {{tip|minions}}, and capped against {{tip|monsters}}. Enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and marked as ''Cursed'' for 4 seconds.
params.description2:
{{sbc|Cursed:}} The target is {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}}, and continually raises a {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} from each nearby ''grave'', up to a maximum of 4.

'''Yorick''', {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} and the '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|The Maiden|nolink=true}}''' gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby ''Cursed'' enemies. {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} will {{tip|dash|leap}} to nearby ''Cursed'' enemy champions and large monsters once, attacking them upon arrival.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|13 to 25}}% of target's armor}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|18 to 30}}%}}
params.notes:
* '''Yorick''' will snap his facing direction towards the target location at the start of the cast time.
* The speed boost toward marked targets does not require {{tip|sight}} of them.
* The {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} do not {{tip|dash|leap}} if they are {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or if the ''marked'' target is {{tip|untargetable}}.
* The damage done by the {{as|Mist Walkers'|mist}} leap shares a {{tip|cast instance}} with ''Mourning Mist''.

blurb.plain: Active: Yorick hurls a globule of Black Mist that splashes at the target location dealing magic damage to enemies. Enemy champions and monsters hit are also shortly slowed, and marked Cursed for a few seconds.

blurb2.plain: Yorick and his summons gain bonus movement speed toward a Cursed target. Mist Walkers will leap to a nearby Cursed target and focus them.

blurb4.plain: Cursed: The target has reduced armor. Nearby graves automatically raise a Mist Walkers.

description.plain: Active: Yorick hurls a globule of Black Mist that splashes across an area at the target location, dealing magic damage to enemies hit, down to a minimum threshold against minions, and capped against monsters. Enemy champions and monsters hit are slowed by 30% for 1.5 seconds and marked as Cursed for 4 seconds.

description2.plain:
Cursed: The target is revealed and inflicted with armor reduction, and continually raises a Mist Walker from each nearby grave, up to a maximum of 4. 
Yorick, Mist Walkers and the Maiden of the Mist gain bonus movement speed while facing nearby Cursed enemies. Mist Walkers will leap to nearby Cursed enemy champions and large monsters once, attacking them upon arrival.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yorick}} summons the '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|nolink=true}}''' and a few {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} at the target location. The ''Maiden'' will automatically raise {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} from dead enemies, and mark her attack target with ''Touch of the Maiden''.
params.blurb2: ''Eulogy of the Isles'' can be recast while the ''Maiden'' is active.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Yorick''' sets the ''Maiden'' free, allowing her to push the nearest lane.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Touch of the Maiden:}} '''Yorick's''' next basic attack will consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} by a portion of the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' summons the '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|nolink=true}}''' {{tt|over {{fd|1.5}} seconds|From the start of the cast time; summons become alive 1 second after cast.}}, along with a number of {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} surrounding her at the target location, which remain on the battlefield until she or '''Yorick''' dies. ''Eulogy of the Isles'' can be recast once while the ''Maiden'' is alive after 10 seconds of the activation.
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Yorick''' sets the ''Maiden'' free, allowing her to push the nearest [[lanes|lane]] until she dies.
params.description3: ''See [[Yorick#Pets|Pets]] for more details about The '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|nolink=true}}'''.''
params.cdstart: Starts after Yorick or the Maiden of the Mist dies
params.notes:
* See the ''Pets'' section below for more details about ''The Maiden of the Mist'' and {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}}.
* The extra {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} spawn 250 units from the ''Maiden'' summon location.
* The ''Maiden'' updates her stats when '''Yorick's''' [[champion statistic|stats]] change, and as ''Eulogy of the Isles'' is ranked up.
* When '''Yorick''' dies, ''The Maiden'' rapidly loses portions of her {{as|'''maximum''' health}} over 3 seconds until she dies.
** The loss of {{as|'''maximum''' health}} occurs in {{fd|0.6}}-second intervals, in which she loses 20% on the first, 25% on the second, {{fd|33.{{recurring|3}}%}} on the third, 50% on the fourth, and 100% on the fifth.
* '''Yorick''' will snap his facing direction towards the target location at the start of the cast time.

blurb2.plain: Eulogy of the Isles can be recast while the Maiden is active.

blurb3.plain: Recast: Yorick sets the Maiden free, allowing her to push the nearest lane.

blurb4.plain: Touch of the Maiden: Yorick's next basic attack will consume the mark to deal bonus magic damage by a portion of the target's maximum health.

description.plain: Active: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist over 1.5 seconds, along with a number of Mist Walkers surrounding her at the target location, which remain on the battlefield until she or Yorick dies. Eulogy of the Isles can be recast once while the Maiden is alive after 10 seconds of the activation.

description2.plain: Recast: Yorick sets the Maiden free, allowing her to push the nearest lane until she dies.

description3.plain: See Pets for more details about The Maiden of the Mist.
